versions.content: Wrong signature for secure coding data If the crypto job to authenticate the secure data has failed, the Dcm shall set the positive response routine parameter DcmDspStartRoutineOutSignal of the DcmSecureCodingValida- tionRoutine to the value of 0x02 to indicate a signature validation failure and send a positive response for the DcmSecureCodingValidationRoutine .
